pub fn __wrela_select_count(core: usize) -> usize:
    match core:
        case 0:
            return 1
        case 1:
            return 1
        case 2:
            return 0
        case _:
            return 0

pub fn __wrela_try_select(core: usize, slot: usize) -> u64:
    match core:
        case 0:
            match slot:
                case 0:
                    return __select_0()
                case _:
                    return 0
        case 1:
            match slot:
                case 0:
                    return __select_1()
                case _:
                    return 0
        case 2:
            return 0
        case _:
            return 0
